div.head: IV Eg 1.7
div.ab: ⁊ þa Godes þeowas, þe þa sceattas underfoð, þe we Gode syllað, libban clænan life, þæt hy þurh þa clænnysse ús to Gode þingian mægen.
⁊ ða Godes þeowas, þe ða sceattas underfoð, þe we Gode syllað, libban clænan life, þæt hy ðurh ða clænnysse ús to Gode þingian mægen.

Sanctęque ęcclesię cultores, per quorum manus transeundum est quod Domino uniuersorum pro nostrarum salute animarum damus, inreprehensibiliter casteque et sancte uiuant, sicut decet Dei ministros, quatinus sua sanctitate pro nobis apud Altissimum mereantur fieri intercessores.
⁊ ða Godes ðeowas þe ða sceattas underfoð, þe we Gode syllað, libban clænan life, þæt hy ðurh ða clænnysse ús to Gode þingian mægen;
And that the servants of God who receive the dues which we render to Him shall live a pure life, so that, by virtue of their purity, they may intercede for us with God.
Und die Geistlichen, welche jene Gelder empfangen, die wir Gott geben, sollen keusches Leben führen, damit sie vermöge dieser Keuschheit für uns zu Gott fürbittend eintreten können.
And the servants of God who receive the payments that we give to God are to live a chaste life, so that through that chastity they may intercede for us with God.
